scope: Four client-controller tests with controlled API/recovery adapters and two actual temporary SQLite store tests
selected_tests: writes complete recovery state before sending and clears it only after acknowledgment
retains recovery state and reports failure when a save fails
turns a stale update into a complete conflict-copy notebook
retains recovery state when creating the conflict copy fails
saves complete immutable revisions and rejects stale or cross-owner writes
rolls back a failed save without advancing the current revision
limits: Client recovery adapters are controlled test doubles; these assertions do not prove every browser crash or storage-failure case.
The store tests use actual temporary SQLite state; they do not establish production authentication or deployment.
The guided example summarizes related tests, not a single live session.
PenEcho upstream authorship remains distinct from the fork notebook work.
